parole.significato: pornography (depiction of sexual subject matter with prurient intent)
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish پورنوغرافیا (pornoğrafya), from Egyptian Arabic بُورْنُوجْرَافِيَا (burnugrāfiyā), پُورْنُوجْرَافِيَا (purnugrāfiyā), from Ancient Greek πορνογράφος (pornográphos).
